en.headline: Government gazettes bill for work injury compensation for delivery platform workers
en.dek: The Digital Platform Workers Compensation Bill, published today, would require food and goods delivery operators to insure workers and pay compensation for injuries or deaths, with first reading set for 9 December.
body: The Government published in the Gazette today the Digital Platform Workers Compensation Bill, which seeks to provide statutory work injury compensation to digital platform workers engaged in food and beverage or goods delivery services.

A Labour Department spokesman said the bill implements measures announced in the 2025 and 2026 Policy Addresses to improve the compensation mechanism through legislation. It also aligns with the First Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to strengthen labour protection for new forms of employment.

Key provisions establish the liability of operators to pay compensation in fatal and non-fatal cases, require them to notify the Commissioner for Labour of accidents, purchase compulsory insurance, keep records and issue payment slips. Platform workers would also have duties to report accidents and undergo medical examinations when requested.

The bill will be introduced into the Legislative Council for first and second readings on 9 December. If passed, it will come into operation in phases to give operators time to prepare for compliance. The Government said it would fully support the legislature’s scrutiny.

zh.headline: 政府刊憲《數碼平台工作者補償條例草案》 為外送員提供工傷補償
zh.dek: 草案今日刊憲，規定餐飲及貨品送遞平台營運商為工作者購買保險並支付工傷或死亡補償，將於十二月九日在立法會首讀。
body: 政府今日在憲報刊登《數碼平台工作者補償條例草案》，旨在為從事餐飲送遞或貨品送遞服務的數碼平台工作者提供法定工傷補償。
勞工處發言人表示，草案落實二〇二五及二〇二六年《施政報告》宣布的措施，以立法方式完善平台工作者的工傷補償機制，並配合《香港特別行政區經濟和社會發展第一個五年規劃》持續健全勞工保障的方向。
草案主要內容包括確立營運商支付補償的法律責任、訂明致命及非致命個案的補償類別，並規定營運商須向勞工處處長發出意外通知、購買強制工傷補償保險、備存紀錄及發出付款憑據。平台工作者亦須報告意外及在要求下接受身體檢查。
草案將於十二月九日提交立法會進行首讀及二讀。如獲通過，將分階段實施，讓營運商有足夠時間準備。政府表示會全力配合立法會審議。
